summary: Rank One Computing Corp (ROC) filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of 100% of Zuccaro Technical Consulting LLC (ZTC) from ZTC Holdco, Inc. and individual sellers under a June 23, 2026 Purchase Agreement. The deal closed August 31, 2026 and was announced via press release September 1, 2026. Terms such as price, premium, and consideration were not disclosed in the excerpt. The acquisition combines digital forensics with ROC's evidence management to expand its Vision AI platform, adding federal relationships and cross-selling opportunities. No board recommendation or advisors were named. Watch for integration execution and revenue contribution from ZTC.
